location_lifecycle.label: Branch Lifecycle
location_lifecycle.help: Operational lifecycle of a co-operative branch or member service location. Occupancy, booking availability, and record activation are separate.

planned.help: The co-operative branch or member service location is being prepared and has not started operating.

operational.help: The co-operative branch or member service location is operating. This does not indicate vacant space or booking availability.

under_maintenance.help: The co-operative branch or member service location is undergoing maintenance; operating restrictions are managed separately.

temporarily_closed.help: Operations at the co-operative branch or member service location are paused with an intention to reopen.

closed.help: Operations have ended at the co-operative branch or member service location.
